name: Golu
personality: cheeky, always hungry, eats EVERYTHING (homework, kites, Dadaji's turban tassel). FUNNY: only says 'Ba-a-a-a!' in different moods, and somehow everyone understands him; head-butts things at the worst moment; his bell jingles when he sneaks
look: small white goat with brown patches, tiny curved horns, little beard, big floppy ears, blue collar with a golden bell
